grand_strategy.reading:
Thailand is the textbook of a state that survives by bending: treaty ally of the
United States, economic partner and now arms customer of China, summit
partner of Putin and Modi, comprehensive strategic partner of Vietnam, and it
has not paid the price of joining any camp. What 2025 added is the rest of
Luttwak's lesson: the same state that yields to every great power fought its
small neighbour, and in that war the bending came back. Bangkok held the ground
(Crisis Group: it holds the high ground and land on both sides of the line)
but the end of the war was set in Washington and Putrajaya, by a tariff threat
to both belligerents, and the accord that Trump named for Kuala Lumpur was
suspended by Thailand within a fortnight of signing. The domestic cycle runs on
the same logic. The courts that removed Paetongtarn over a telephone call to
Hun Sen made the border a test of loyalty, Anutin took office on it, called his
election in the middle of the fighting and won 192 seats, and has to govern
with Thaksin's party; the monarchy and Section 112 stay outside every bargain,
the 2026 amnesty included. Adversary or rival: Thailand's grade of Cambodia is
rival, because neither government seeks the other's end (the 27 Dec 2025
statement commits both to demarcation through the Joint Boundary Commission and
ICG's recommendations are about a thaw), though the fighting was the deadliest
between the two in decades. Three signals are not rows: Anutin was the first
ASEAN leader to congratulate Min Aung Hlaing as president (April 2026) and
hosted him in August, a thaw that reverses the 2025 power cut; the United
States put a 12.5% tariff on Thai goods in July 2026 while the reciprocal
agreement is described as 'at the last paragraph'; and the Cambodian frontier
stays shut to trade while both sides insist that the ceasefire holds. Relational
manoeuvre against Thailand therefore does not pass through its alliances but
through its seams: a treaty ally that buys Chinese submarines and Swedish jets,
a neighbour of Cambodia that needs a Malaysian mediator and an American
patron to end its own war, and a junta it needs more than it respects.

stances.note: Adversary or rival: rival. The July 2025 war (24-28 Jul, at least 43 dead, over 300,000 displaced) and the December 2025 round (at least 47 dead, over a million displaced in three weeks) were the deadliest fighting between the two in decades, and Cambodia says Thailand illegally occupies its territory. But neither government seeks the other's end or regime: both signed the 26 Oct 2025 Kuala Lumpur declaration, both defence ministers signed the 27 Dec 2025 ceasefire statement (direct lines, frozen positions, demarcation through the Joint Boundary Commission), and Crisis Group's October 2026 report is titled 'Toward a Thaw'. Thailand keeps the high ground and sees little reason to change the status quo; trade is down 40%. No source uses the word 'rival': the grade is our reading of the structure (confidence C). Bond - grievance: the Preah Vihear clashes and the ambassadors recalled in Nov 2009, and the 2025 war.
